sources.title: Tina: Tiny Reasoning Models via LoRA - GitHub
sources.snippet: This repository contains the code for the Tina project, accompanying the paper Tina: Tiny Reasoning Models via LoRA. We in this project try to answer the question "How cost-effectively can one perform reinforcement learning to efficiently instill reasoning abilities in language models?"
